description: 4 adversarial boundary cases D1-D4 for #530 — distinct codes, no execution (D4 no success return). D1 UnknownOperation, D2 ValidationFailed, D3 PolicyDenied, D4 OutputValidationFailed. All require code-distinguishable handling.

cases.title: D1 UnknownOperation — hallucinated / absent capability
cases.description: Op not in authoritative registry nor sandbox preselected surface. Exact ID only; no fuzzy matching. Must be UnknownOperation at sandbox before validation/policy/execution, no side effects.
cases.note: Variants with typo/casing/prefix/path traversal all map to same code per failure-taxonomy.md

cases.title: D2 ValidationFailed — malformed that would bypass if not caught
cases.description: Schema-valid op_id but payload violates hidden constraints: title maxLength 200 and additionalProperties:false (admin unknown). Even with valid op_id, runtime validation must catch before policy/execution; no bypass.

cases.title: D3 PolicyDenied — schema-valid but policy-denied
cases.description: Call passes sandbox exact-ID and authoritative JSON Schema validation; runtime policy denies (deny list or resource deny). Must be PolicyDenied at policy boundary after validation:pass, distinguishable from ValidationFailed, no execution.

cases.title: D4 OutputValidationFailed — output schema violation post-execution
cases.description: Input validates and executes, but runtime produces output that violates outputSchema (e.g., rename total→count, items→results, remove facets). Runtime.validate_output must catch before returning success; code OutputValidationFailed (mapped to ValidationFailed with boundary runtime:output) distinct from input ValidationFailed/UnknownOperation/PolicyDenied; no success returned.
cases.note: In harness error-codes.md this is ValidationFailed with boundary runtime:output; failure-taxonomy.md records distinct logical code OutputValidationFailed for D4 reporting
